arxiv-2107-00017.title: The Hough Stream Spotter : A New Method for Detecting Linear Structure in Resolved Stars and Application to the Stellar Halo of M31 Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al.
arxiv-2107-00017.creator: Sarah Pearson, Susan E. Clark, Alexis J. Demirjian, Kathryn V. Johnston, Melissa K. Ness, Tjitske K. Starkenburg, Benjamin F. Williams, Rodrigo A. Ibata
arxiv-2107-00017.description: Abstract Stellar streams from globular clusters (GCs) offer constraints on the nature of dark matter and have been used to explore the dark matter halo structure and substructure of our Galaxy. Detection of GC streams in other galaxies would broaden this endeavor to a cosmological context, yet no such streams have been detected to date.

arxiv-2204-11529.title: Filling space with hypercubes of two sizes – The pythagorean tiling in higher dimensions
arxiv-2204-11529.creator: Jakob Führer
arxiv-2204-11529.description: Abstract 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 52C22, 51M20, 05B45 Abstract We construct a unilateral lattice tiling of \mathbb{R}^{n} into hypercubes of two differnet side lengths p or q . This generalizes the Pythagorean tiling in \mathbb{R}^{2} . We also show that this tiling is unique up to symmetries, which proves a variation of a conjecture by Bölcskei from 2001.

arxiv-2206-11220.title: Event-Based Imaging of Levitated Microparticles
arxiv-2206-11220.creator: Yugang Ren, Enrique Benedetto, Harry Borrill, Yelizaveta Savchuk, Molly Message, Katie O’Flynn, Muddassar Rashid, James Millen
arxiv-2206-11220.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yugang Ren, Enrique Benedetto, Harry Borrill, Yelizaveta Savchuk, Molly Message, Katie O’Flynn, Muddassar Rashid, James Millen. ABSTRACT Event-based imaging is a neuromorphic detection technique whereby an array of pixels detects a positive or negative change in light intensity at each pixel, and is hence particularly well suited to detecting motion. As compared to standard camera technology, an event-based camera reduces redundancy by not detecting regions of the image where there is no motion, allowing increased frame-rates without compromising on field-of-view.

arxiv-2407-18862.title: Correcting for objective sample refractive index mismatch in extended field of view selective plane illumination microscopy
arxiv-2407-18862.creator: Steven J. Sheppard, Peter T. Brown, Douglas P. Shepherd
arxiv-2407-18862.description: Abstract Selective plane illumination microscopy (SPIM) is an optical sectioning imaging approach based on orthogonal light pathways for excitation and detection. The excitation pathway has an inverse relation between the optical sectioning strength and the effective field of view (FOV).

arxiv-2410-09684.title: Technical Design Review of Duke Robotics Club’s Oogway: An AUV for RoboSub 2024
arxiv-2410-09684.creator: Will Denton, Michael Bryant, Lilly Chiavetta, Vedarsh Shah, Rico Zhu, Philip Xue
arxiv-2410-09684.description: Abstract The Duke Robotics Club is proud to present our robot for the 2024 RoboSub Competition: Oogway. Now in its second year, Oogway has been dramatically upgraded in both its capabilities and reliability. Oogway was built on the principle of independent, well-integrated, and reliable subsystems. Individual components and subsystems were tested and designed separately.

arxiv-2410-23037.title: Accurate Solutions to Optimal Control Problems via a Flexible Mesh and Integrated Residual Transcription
arxiv-2410-23037.creator: Lucian Nita, Eric C. Kerrigan
arxiv-2410-23037.description: Abstract We propose joining a flexible mesh design with an integrated residual transcription in order to improve the accuracy of numerical solutions to optimal control problems. This approach is particularly useful when state or input trajectories are non-smooth, but it may also be beneficial when dynamics constraints are stiff.

arxiv-2509-18270.title: The Streaming Instability in 3D: Conditions for Strong Clumping Julia ( J. Bezanson et al. 2017 ) , Makie.jl ( S. Danisch & J. Krumbiegel 2021 ) , Athena ( J. M. Stone et al. 2008 ; J. M. Stone & T. A. Gardiner 2010 ; X.-N. Bai & J. M. Stone 2010b ) , ChatGPT ( OpenAI et al. 2023 )
arxiv-2509-18270.creator: Jeonghoon Lim (임정훈), Jacob B. Simon, Rixin Li (李日新), Olivia Brouillette, David G. Rea, Wladimir Lyra
arxiv-2509-18270.description: Abstract The streaming instability (SI) is a leading mechanism for planetesimal formation, driving the aerodynamic concentration of solids in protoplanetary disks. The SI triggers strong clumping (i.e., strong enough for clumps to collapse) when the solid-to-gas column density ratio, Z Z , exceeds a threshold, Z crit Z_{\rm{crit}} .

arxiv-2511-15744.title: AnonLFI 2.0: Extensible Architecture for PII Pseudonymization in CSIRTs with OCR and Technical Recognizers
arxiv-2511-15744.creator: Cristhian Kapelinski, Douglas Lautert, Beatriz Machado, Diego Kreutz
arxiv-2511-15744.description: Abstract This work presents AnonLFI 2.0, a modular pseudonymization framework for CSIRTs that uses HMAC-SHA256 to generate strong and reversible pseudonyms, preserves XML and JSON structures, and integrates OCR and technical recognizers for PII and security artifacts. In two case studies—OCR on PDF and OpenVAS XML report—the system achieved 100% precision and F1 scores of 76.5% and 92.

pmc-11683581.title: Characteristics and Guardianship Status of Children Undergoing Forensic Medical and Psychological Evaluation for Asylum in Miami
pmc-11683581.creator: Marina Plesons, Haley Hullfish, Priyashma Joshi, Stephen Symes, Anjali Saxena
pmc-11683581.description: To add to the limited evidence on forensic medical and psychological evaluations of children experiencing distress migration and seeking asylum in the United States, this paper describes the sociodemographic characteristics, nature of human rights violations, and guardianship status of the children served by the Human Rights Clinic of Miami from 2010 to 2021.

pmc-12590248.title: Operational assessment of tattooless breast radiotherapy using AlignRT surface guidance
pmc-12590248.creator: Aria Malhotra, Andrew KH Robertson, Ian Sun, Samantha AM Lloyd
pmc-12590248.description: Highlights•Radiotherapy tattoos pose a negative mental burden on cancer survivors.•Replacing tattoos with surface guidance for breast radiotherapy will not impact clinical operations.•Tattooless breast radiotherapy is feasible with current surface guidance technology.Keywords: AlignRT, Surface guidance, Patient positioning, Radiotherapy, Tattoos Introduction Reproducible patient positioning is an important part of radiotherapy (RT) treatments.

pmc-12619628.title: Beyond the Break: Radiologic Diagnosis and Outcomes of Necrotizing Fasciitis Complicating Orthopedic Fractures
pmc-12619628.creator: Kiranjot Kaur, Muhammad Zain Ul Abidin, Shahmeen Rasul, Ahmed M Mohamed, Karthika Kalissery Biju Chandrasekhar, Shenouda R Shehata Abdelmesih, Jarallah H. J. Alkhazendar, Faiqa Ijaz, Aliaa H Alkhazendar, Riyan Khalid, Mohit H Buch
pmc-12619628.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Necrotizing fasciitis (NF) is a rapidly progressive infection with high mortality. When NF complicates orthopedic fractures, early recognition is particularly challenging because swelling, erythema, and pain may be misattributed to trauma or postoperative changes. A systematic review was conducted using PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Cochrane databases up to June 2025 according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 guidelines. Eligible studies included human patients with orthopedic fractures complicated by NF in whom radiologic evaluation and clinical outcomes were reported.

pmc-12861719.title: RNA‐Based Therapies for Inherited Metabolic Disorders
pmc-12861719.creator: Reddy Sreekanth Vootukuri, Sonam Gurung, Roopkatha Ghosh, Philippa B Mills, Julien Baruteau, Haiyan Zhou
pmc-12861719.description: Inherited metabolic disorders (IMDs) are a diverse and complex group of genetic conditions resulting from deficiencies in enzymes, transporters, or cofactors. These deficiencies lead to metabolic dysfunction and severe clinical consequences. Despite significant progress in understanding their molecular basis, treatment options remain limited for many IMDs.

pmc-13112395.title: Deep learning analysis of soybean cyst nematode effectors to proven soybean resistance genes and homolog identification in the sugar beet-sugar beet root maggot plant pathosystem
pmc-13112395.creator: Sidra S Rahim, Yerang Lee, Nadim W Alkharouf, Chenggen Chu, Vincent P Klink
pmc-13112395.description: Sugar beet (Beta vulgaris ssp. vulgaris) is one of two plants from which sugar is broadly produced, accounting for 55% of U.S. sugar ($1B, U.S.) and 35% global raw sugar ($4.6B), annually. The sugar beet root maggot (Tetanops myopaeformis) is its top pathogen in the U.S., and capable of causing total crop failure, making its study of urgent need.

pmc-13444104.title: Distinct epigenetic alterations and accelerated mitotic aging define second primary breast cancers
pmc-13444104.creator: Andrés F Bedoya-López, Javier I J Orozco, Pere Llinàs‑Arias, Miquel Ensenyat-Mendez, Betsy J Valdez, Sandra Iñiguez‑Muñoz, Mar Morote-Llabrés, Chikako Matsuba, Matthew P Salomon, Diego M Marzese, Melanie Goldfarb
pmc-13444104.description: As cancer survivorship is steadily increasing, second primary breast cancers (SPBCs) are becoming a more common disease linked to poorer clinical outcomes compared to first primary breast cancers (FPBCs). While the molecular features of FPBCs are well characterized, the biological drivers of SPBCs remain largely unexplored.

pmc-13598216.title: The ecology of urban segregation
pmc-13598216.creator: Steward T. A. Pickett, Timon McPhearson
pmc-13598216.description: ing from individual preferences (8) to intentional and institutionalized discrimination (9, 10). This paper introduces a special feature on the “ecology of segregation,” which is an emerging social–ecological integration. It brings together major strands from various social sciences, including scholarly literature on environmental justice, and from contemporary urban ecological science.

pmc-13634501.title: Salmonella in broiler breeder flocks in Israel during 2008-2018: Prevalence, risk factors and repeated detections
pmc-13634501.creator: Anat Wiseman, Hadas Poria Daly, Ehud Elnekave
pmc-13634501.description: Non-typhoidal Salmonella infections in broiler breeder flocks pose a major economic challenge to poultry production and increased risk to public health. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and risk factors for infections in commercial broiler breeder flocks in Israel, and the risk for repeated detections.

pmc-13647626.title: Hand hygiene knowledge, glove use misconceptions, and determinants among healthcare workers in Addis Ababa hospitals: a mixed-method cross-sectional study
pmc-13647626.creator: Abayneh Melaku, Tesfaye Admassu, Argaw Ambelu
pmc-13647626.description: BackgroundHand hygiene is a cornerstone of infection prevention, yet compliance among healthcare workers remains low. Despite multiple national initiatives, adherence in Ethiopian hospitals continues to be sub-optimal. This challenge is partly due to knowledge gaps and misconceptions, particularly regarding the WHO “Five Moments” and the appropriate use of gloves.
